weapon.d: Grants Def+3. After combat, if unit attacked, deals 10 damage to target and foes within 2 spaces of target, and inflicts status on those foes preventing counterattacks through their next actions.

special.d: If foe is 2 spaces from unit, reduces damage from foe's attack by 30%.
If foe is 2 spaces from unit, reduces damage from foe's attack by 50%.

builds.name: Grannvale's General
builds.desc: Kempf is an easily-accessible unit, and thus relatively easy to +10. This build capitalises on his weapon, and does a whopping 21 after-battle damage, as well as preventing counterattacks. This build is especially useful in Pawns of Loki. His special skills are intended to either deal a little bit more damage, or keep him going for a little longer, and charge very quickly.
